title: Materials
values: Electronics and batteries consume metals and plastics; the reference power budget uses an AGM lead-acid battery.
Choose RoHS-compliant parts, a stainless cage and a recyclable enclosure.

title: Assembly
values: Assembly uses energy and creates offcuts and packaging.
Assemble in Hanoi to cut shipping and support local jobs.

title: Transport
values: Short trips by van; each station weighs only a few kilograms.
Group installations by district to cut trips.

title: Installation
values: Work on embankment walls beside traffic and water.
Agree access, follow safety rules and tell residents before work starts.

title: Use
values: Solar powered, but needs service trips and calibration chemicals.
Collect used calibration fluid and plan visits by route.

title: End of life
values: Retired boards become e-waste; AGM batteries need suitable lead-acid collection.
Review wear in month 36, replace parts only as needed, recycle boards and batteries and reuse cages.
